caseName: Stadler v. State Board of Equalization of California
caseNameFull: STADLER, EXECUTORS v. STATE BOARD OF EQUALIZATION OF CALIFORNIA
attorneys: Theodore W. Russell and R. Y. Schureman for appellants., Thomas C. Lynch, Attorney General of California, Dan Kaufman, Assistant Attorney General, and Neal J. Oobar, Deputy Attorney General, for appellee.
